title: Relationships & social life (B1)
note: Course-doc theme, above leaf_family_a2. How people get on, fall out and stay in touch. Phrasal-heavy, so it pretaught-feeds leaf_phrasal_2_b1. First draft 2026-09-02. · 2026-09-04 B1 loop: 16 of the 36 tiles were words already taught before this slot (colleague, neighbour, partner, couple, guest, invite, celebrate, chat, apologise, support, argue, tension, miss, gossip, jealous, misunderstanding). F7/F8: they moved to two **You already know** review boards and the Match list was refilled with 16 relationship words that are new here. A12: *date (romantic)* is sense-marked, and the frames note now separates this pack's **miss** (stýskat se) from Travel 2's **miss** (zmeškat). · sentences 8 → 36, one gappable frame per lemma. Two of the eight shipped frames could never gap: *let you down* and *broke up* do not contain the lemma string. E10: Use is use_mode rewrite, 12 underlined paraphrases. · The frames page offered noun frames (I have a … / I need a …) on a pack that is mostly phrasal verbs; they are the pack's own shapes now. · Pool-checked against everything taught before leaf_relationships_b1 — 0 unknown types. · 2026-09-04: four rewrite items re-cut so replacing the underline reconstructs the answer.
